text: dsh-fakeip-http 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的 Fake-IP DNS 兼容插件。它在 web 服务中找到内置 HTTP fetch provider，并包装地址解析函数；只有原校验拒绝后，才对普通域名使用本地 DNS 查询，并要求完整 A/AAAA 应答均属于配置的合成 CIDR。适合通过 Clash、Mihomo、sing-box 或 Surge 的 Fake-IP/TUN 环境使用 web_fetch。无需 API key；需要本地 DNS 能访问转发器。

dsh-fakeip-http enables web_fetch with Fake-IP DNS. It wraps the built-in HTTP provider and retries rejected hostname resolution through local DNS when all A/AAAA answers fit configured synthetic CIDR ranges. For Fake-IP forwarders such as Clash or Mihomo. No API key is needed.
我在 Fake-IP DNS 和 TUN 环境里用 web_fetch 时总遇到域名解析被拒，怎么兼容？
How can I use web_fetch when my DNS forwarder returns synthetic Fake-IP addresses?
让 Harness 的网页抓取能识别 Clash 或 Mihomo 返回的合成 DNS 地址。
dsh-fakeip-http 的功能「Fake-IP 地址解析兼容」：web_fetch 使用内置 HTTP provider 时，插件仅在原校验拒绝后查询本地 DNS；完整应答均在配置网段内才继续请求。
dsh-fakeip-http 的功能「Fake-IP 地址段配置」：插件接受 enabled 与 cidrs 配置，默认地址段为 IPv4 198.18.0.0/15 和 IPv6 2001:2::/48；与特殊用途范围重叠的段会被排除。
dsh-fakeip-http 使用本地 DNS 查询解析被拒绝的普通域名，之后 web_fetch 仍会按解析结果连接目标站点；DNS 必须能访问使用中的 Fake-IP 转发器。

dsh-fakeip-http README · Fake-IP Web Fetch：[](https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fakeip-http)
[](LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Make `web_fetch` work behind a **fake-IP DNS + TUN** setup without weakening
Harness's SSRF guard. Loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation,
reserved, and IP-literal destinations stay blocked.

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Preview：In a fake-IP environment, `web_fetch` enters the fallback only after the
built-in guard rejects the name.

```text
  web_fetch
     │
     ▼
  built-in SSRF guard ─── public ──────────────▶ unchanged

The plugin does not add an allowlist entry: the public guard still owns the
first decision.

dsh-fakeip-http README · The problem：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` resolves a destination before sending the
request and requires the **complete DNS answer set** to be public unicast. One
non-public answer is enough to fail:

```text
URL hostname "example.com" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

A fake-IP forwarder (Clash/Mihomo, sing-box, Surge, ...) answers almost every
name with an address from a reserved block, then maps the connection back to
the real destination inside its TUN. A host can look like this:

dsh-fakeip-http README · The problem：```text
example.com    -> 198.18.0.100, 2001:2::56
www.google.com -> 198.18.0.9,   2001:2::9
```

Those addresses are in the benchmarking ranges (RFC 2544 for IPv4, RFC 5180
for IPv6), so the built-in guard rejects the URL before a connection exists.
`curl` and a plain Node `fetch` succeed because they do not inspect the resolved
addresses.

dsh-fakeip-http README · The fix：The plugin does **not** replace the provider and does **not** widen
`web.fetchProvider=http`. It finds the built-in `HttpFetchProvider` instance
and wraps the instance's `resolveAddresses` function:

dsh-fakeip-http README · The fix：1. **Run the original validator first.** A public destination, or a host with
   no fake-IP answer, follows the original path unchanged.
2. Only when the original validator throws `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` does the wrapper
   resolve the same hostname locally.
3. Accept the answer only when **the complete answer set** — every A and AAAA
   record — is inside an explicitly configured synthetic CIDR, and the hostname
   is eligible for fake-IP forwarding.
4. Return those synthetic addresses. The provider pins the connection to them
   exactly as it pins real public addresses; TLS SNI and the `Host` header stay
   the original hostname, so the TUN can map the connection back.
5. On any policy failure, rethrow the **original** error with a short
   diagnostic suffix.

dsh-fakeip-http README · The fix：This is not "add `198.18.0.0/15` to an allowlist". It is "accept this one
resolution only because the built-in guard already rejected it, the whole
answer set is synthetic, the name is an ordinary DNS name, and the synthetic
block cannot point at local or special-use space".

dsh-fakeip-http README · Safety invariants：| Case | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Public real address | Original validator passes; unchanged. |
| Loopback / RFC 1918 / CGNAT / link-local / multicast / documentation / reserved | Refused; the fallback only accepts configured synthetic blocks. |
| IP literal (`http://198.18.0.1/`, `http://[2001:2::1]/`) | Always refused; never enters the fallback. |
| `localhost`, `*.localhost`, `*.local`, `*.lan`, `*.internal`, `*.home`, `*.corp`, `*.private`, `*.home.arpa`, `*.arpa`, `*.test`, `*.example`, `*.invalid`, single-label names | Never eligible for fake-IP. |
| Answer set mixes fake-IP and real addresses | Refused as ambiguous / DNS pollution. |
| Empty answer set or DNS failure | Original error. |
| Configured CIDR overlaps loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation, or other special-use space | Refused at load time, logged, and excluded from the policy. |
| IPv4-mapped IPv6 answer (`::ffff:198.18.0.1`) | Matched against the IPv4 synthetic blocks. |
| Explicit HTTP(S) proxy | Still resolved by the proxy (original logic); unaffected. |
| Every redirect hop | Re-resolved, re-validated, re-pinned (original logic). |

dsh-fakeip-http README · Safety invariants：The special-use rejection closes an important hole: without it, a user could
configure `cidrs: [127.0.0.0/8]` or `fc00::/7` and turn the fallback into a
local-network gateway. A synthetic block must not overlap any range in
`SPECIAL_USE_CIDRS`; invalid or unsafe entries are logged and the remaining safe
ranges stay active.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Why it is disabled by default：`enabled` defaults to `false` in code. The shipped `cordis.patch.yml` sets it
to `true` explicitly. Installing the package without the patch therefore does
not silently relax the guard; removing the config from the patch restores the
strict behavior.
section: Why it is disabled by default

text:
dsh-fakeip-http README · Install：Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web, `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.x`.
- `web.fetchProvider` must remain `http` (the default).
- A fake-IP forwarder reachable through the local resolver, with its synthetic
  range known.

dsh-fakeip-http README · From npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fakeip-http
```

Published as [`dsh-fakeip-http`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fakeip-http)
by the `jayve-dev` npm account. The package is unscoped, so the install path is
just the package name.

dsh-fakeip-http README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http
```

dsh-fakeip-http README · From a checkout：```sh
git clone https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-fakeip-http
```

The desktop app usually uses the `desktop` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-fakeip-http
```

The package is plain JavaScript with no dependencies and no build step, so git
and npm installs need no pnpm build approval and no `prepare` script.

Restart the Harness process after installation, then verify the layer:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```
dsh-fakeip-http README · From a checkout：Look for `# == dsh-fakeip-http` and an `enabled: true` fake-IP row.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Verify：In a new session:

```text
web_fetch https://example.com
```

Expected: HTTP 200 and the page body. Then check that the guard is still
strict:

```text
web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:1203/   # still fails (loopback)
web_fetch http://198.18.0.1/      # still fails (IP literal, no fallback)
web_fetch http://10.0.0.1/        # still fails (private)
```

dsh-fakeip-http README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-fakeip-http
```

Removing the bundle removes its patch layer; `web.fetchProvider` is untouched.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Migrating from a local build：A local development row such as `@local/dsh-fakeip-http` uses the same row id
(`fakeip-http`). Remove that bundle first, then add this one, so the composed
config does not contain two rows with the same id.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: fakeip-http
  name: dsh-fakeip-http
  config:
    enabled: true

- `enabled` (default `false`): accept synthetic answers. The shipped patch sets
  it to `true`.
- `cidrs` (default `198.18.0.0/15`, `2001:2::/48`): synthetic blocks the policy
  may accept. IPv4 and IPv6 both work. A block that overlaps special-use space
  is refused and logged; if every configured block is refused, the defaults
  apply.

Find your forwarder's range before changing this:

dsh-fakeip-http README · Configuration：| Forwarder | Typical setting |
| --- | --- |
| Clash / Mihomo | `dns.fake-ip-range` (often `198.18.0.1/16`) |
| sing-box | fake-IP DNS server `inet4_range` / `inet6_range` |
| Surge | fake-IP range in DNS settings |

Use the range your forwarder actually emits. If it emits an IPv6 range as well,
include both. A range such as `28.0.0.0/8` is accepted if your forwarder uses it;
a private or ULA range is not, because that would expose the local network.

dsh-fakeip-http README · How it fits together：```text
web_fetch
   -> HttpFetchProvider.resolveAddresses
      -> built-in public-IP guard
         -> public: unchanged

The wrapper lives on the provider instance as an own property
(`resolveAddresses`). It is deliberately small because it depends on an
internal provider detail; see [Limitations](#limitations).

The policy module has no third-party imports and can be tested on its own. The
full threat model is in [docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md).

section: Why not just allow the range globally?

text:
dsh-fakeip-http README · Why not just allow the range globally?：The plugin keeps every original refusal and only adds a narrow, configurable
synthetic path for ordinary hostnames.
section: Why not just allow the range globally?

text:
dsh-fakeip-http README · Limitations：- It wraps only the built-in `http` fetch provider. If `web.fetchProvider` is
  changed, the plugin has no effect.
- It only affects `web_fetch`. `web_search`, model requests, MCP servers, and
  other HTTP clients do their own resolution and do not need this plugin.
- If the forwarder maps a public name to a private address, that is the
  forwarder's policy. The plugin stops the application from directly reaching
  private space; it does not audit the forwarder's rules.
- It depends on `resolveAddresses` being an own property of the provider
  instance. A Harness release that changes that internal structure requires a
  plugin update. The better long-term fix is an upstream `fakeIp` config in
  `dsh-web-fetch-http` (see below).
- A synthetic range that is not routed by the TUN will fail at connect time.
  That is a forwarder configuration problem, not a policy failure.
- Split DNS that returns both fake and real answers for one name is refused by
  design; fix the split-horizon rule instead of forcing the plugin to guess.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Check |
| --- | --- |
| `web_fetch` still reports a non-public address | Confirm the plugin is active in `dsh --profile web --dump-config`; confirm `web.fetchProvider` is `http`; confirm the DNS answer is inside the configured `cidrs`, not a different block. |
| Only IPv6 sites fail | The forwarder returns an IPv6 fake-IP range that is not in `cidrs`, or returns mixed A/AAAA families. Add the IPv6 range. |
| `web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:1203/` works | That would be a regression. The guard must reject it; report it privately (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). |
| Connection times out after the guard passes | The TUN is not running or does not route the synthetic block. Check the forwarder. |
| Log says `no safe fake-IP ranges` | Every configured range overlapped special-use space. Use a non-private synthetic block. |
| Log says `built-in http fetch provider not found` | The row activated before the provider and the 10-second retry expired. Restart with the standard `web-fetch-http` bundle; if it persists, open an issue with the composition. |

dsh-fakeip-http README · Security：The policy is intentionally conservative. Read
[docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md) for the attacker model, the
list of refused ranges, and the residual risks. Report a bypass privately via
GitHub Security Advisories; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-fakeip-http README · Compatibility：| Component | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`) |
| Fetch provider | Built-in `http` provider of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` |
| Node (development only) | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |

The plugin is unit-tested on Node 24 with synthetic DNS answers. The provider
integration follows the built-in provider's `resolveAddresses` contract; it has
not been exercised against every forwarder.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Development：No dependencies and no build step:

```sh
npm test          # node --test: policy + provider wrapper + manifest
npm run pack:check
```

Layout:

```text
index.js                Provider wrapper and lifecycle
lib/policy.js           Hostname, CIDR, and special-use policy
test/policy.test.mjs    Resolution and range-safety tests
test/plugin.test.mjs    Wrapper install/uninstall and apply lifecycle

To iterate in a real profile, from the repository root:

dsh-fakeip-http README · Development：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh web --profile web
```

Host edits require a process restart. There is no client half, so no page
reload is needed after a restart.

dsh-fakeip-http README · Upstream proposal：Such a config must also reject ranges that overlap special-use space, refuse IP
literals and local names, and require the complete answer set to be synthetic.
Without those rules it is a security regression, not a feature.

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

让 `web_fetch` 在 **Fake-IP DNS + TUN 转发** 环境中正常工作，同时保留 Harness 原有的 SSRF 防护：环回、内网、链路本地、组播、文档、保留地址和 IP 字面量仍然一律拒绝。

> 非官方社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系，也未获其背书。
section: Fake-IP 网络抓取（Fake-IP Web Fetch）

text:
dsh-fakeip-http README · 预览：在 Fake-IP 环境里，`web_fetch` 只在原校验器拒绝之后才进入兜底。

```text
  web_fetch
     │
     ▼
  内置 SSRF 校验器 ─── 公网 ──────────────▶ 原样通过

插件没有把整段地址加进白名单：第一个判断仍然由内置校验器完成。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 问题：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 在发请求前会解析目标域名，并要求**整个 DNS 应答集**都是公网 unicast 地址；只要有一个地址不是，就抛出：

```text
URL hostname "example.com" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

Fake-IP 转发器（Clash/Mihomo、sing-box、Surge 等）会把几乎每个域名都解析到保留段，再由 TUN 在连接时映射回真实目标。例如本机实际观测到：

```text
example.com    -> 198.18.0.100, 2001:2::56
www.google.com -> 198.18.0.9,   2001:2::9
```
dsh-fakeip-http README · 问题：这些地址都在基准测试段（IPv4 为 RFC 2544 的 `198.18.0.0/15`，IPv6 为 RFC 5180 的 `2001:2::/48`）里，于是内置校验器在真正建立连接之前就失败了。命令行 `curl` 和普通 Node `fetch` 却能成功，因为它们不检查解析结果。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 方案：插件不替换 provider，也不放宽 `web.fetchProvider=http`。它找到内置 `HttpFetchProvider` 实例，在实例的 `resolveAddresses` 外面包一层：

1. **先跑原校验器。** 公网目标、或没有 Fake-IP 应答的域名完全走原路径，行为不变。
2. 只有原校验器抛出 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` 时，才用同一个域名做一次本地 DNS 解析。
3. 只有**完整应答集**——每一条 A 和 AAAA 记录——都落在显式配置的合成 CIDR 内，且域名本身符合条件时，才接受这次解析。
4. 返回这些合成地址。provider 随后照常把连接 **pin** 到该地址集；TLS SNI 和 `Host` 仍是原域名，TUN 据此完成转发。
5. 任何策略检查失败，都继续抛**原错误**，并附加一行简短诊断。

因此这不是“把 `198.18.0.0/15` 加进白名单”，而是“只在原校验器已经判定目标为非公网、完整应答集都是合成地址、域名本身是普通 DNS 名、且合成段不会指向本地或特殊用途地址时，才接受这一次解析”。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 安全不变量：| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 公网真实地址 | 原校验器通过，行为不变。 |
| 环回 / RFC1918 / CGNAT / 链路本地 / 组播 / 文档 / 保留地址 | 拒绝；Fake-IP 兜底只认配置的合成段。 |
| IP 字面量（`http://198.18.0.1/`、`http://[2001:2::1]/`） | 永远拒绝，不进入兜底。 |
| `localhost`、`*.localhost`、`*.local`、`*.lan`、`*.internal`、`*.home`、`*.corp`、`*.private`、`*.home.arpa`、`*.arpa`、`*.test`、`*.example`、`*.invalid`、单标签名 | 永远不参与 Fake-IP。 |
| 应答集混有 Fake-IP 和真实地址 | 视为歧义/DNS 污染，全部拒绝。 |
| 应答集为空或 DNS 失败 | 抛原错误。 |
| 配置的 CIDR 与环回、内网、链路本地、组播、文档或其它特殊用途段重叠 | 加载时拒绝并记录日志，不进入策略。 |
| IPv4-mapped IPv6 应答（`::ffff:198.18.0.1`） | 按 IPv4 合成段匹配。 |
| 显式 HTTP(S) 代理路径 | 仍由代理解析目标（原逻辑），不受影响。 |
| 重定向的每一跳 | 重新解析、重新校验、重新 pin（原逻辑）。 |
dsh-fakeip-http README · 安全不变量：特殊用途段检查堵住了一个关键漏洞：没有它，用户可以配置 `cidrs: [127.0.0.0/8]` 或 `fc00::/7`，把兜底逻辑变成访问内网的通道。合成段不得与 `SPECIAL_USE_CIDRS` 中任何一段重叠；非法或不安全的条目会被记录并排除，其余安全段继续生效。
dsh-fakeip-http README · 为什么默认关闭：`enabled` 在代码里默认是 `false`；随包提供的 `cordis.patch.yml` 显式设为 `true`。这样“安装了包但没启用”不会静默放宽安全边界；从 patch 里删掉配置即可回到严格模式。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 安装：环境要求：

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 或 Web，版本 `0.2.1-rc.2` 至 `0.2.x`。
- `web.fetchProvider` 保持为 `http`（默认值）。
- 本地解析器能访问 Fake-IP 转发器，且知道它使用的合成段。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 从 npm 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fakeip-http
```

已发布为 [`dsh-fakeip-http`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fakeip-http)，npm 维护者账号为 `jayve-dev`。包名不带 scope，安装路径就是包名本身。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http
```

dsh-fakeip-http README · 从本地 checkout 安装：```sh
git clone https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-fakeip-http
```

桌面版通常使用 `desktop` profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-fakeip-http
```

包是纯 JavaScript，没有依赖也没有构建步骤，因此从 npm 或 GitHub 安装都不需要 pnpm 构建授权，也不需要 `prepare` 脚本。

安装后重启 Harness 进程，然后确认配置层：

```sh

```

应能看到 `# == dsh-fakeip-http`，以及 `enabled: true` 的 Fake-IP 行。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 验证：在新会话中执行：

```text
web_fetch https://example.com
```

预期返回 HTTP 200 和页面正文。然后回归验证安全边界：

```text
web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:1203/   # 仍应失败（环回）
web_fetch http://198.18.0.1/      # 仍应失败（IP 字面量，不进入兜底）
web_fetch http://10.0.0.1/        # 仍应失败（内网）
```

dsh-fakeip-http README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-fakeip-http
```

移除 bundle 会同时移除它的 patch 层；`web.fetchProvider` 不受影响。
dsh-fakeip-http README · 从本地版本迁移：`@local/dsh-fakeip-http` 之类的本地开发行使用同一个行 id（`fakeip-http`）。请先移除旧 bundle，再安装本插件，避免组合配置里出现两行相同 id。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 配置：```yaml
- id: fakeip-http
  name: dsh-fakeip-http
  config:
    enabled: true

- `enabled`（默认 `false`）：是否接受合成应答。随包 patch 显式设为 `true`。
- `cidrs`（默认 `198.18.0.0/15`、`2001:2::/48`）：允许的合成地址段，IPv4/IPv6 均可。与特殊用途段重叠的配置会被拒绝并记录；如果所有配置都被拒绝，回退到默认值。

修改前先确认转发器实际使用的段：

| 转发器 | 常见配置项 |
| --- | --- |
| Clash / Mihomo | `dns.fake-ip-range`（常见 `198.18.0.1/16`） |
| sing-box | fake-IP DNS server 的 `inet4_range` / `inet6_range` |
| Surge | DNS 设置中的 fake-IP range |
dsh-fakeip-http README · 配置：请填写转发器实际返回的段。如果它也返回 IPv6 合成地址，就把两段都写上。`28.0.0.0/8` 这类非特殊用途段可以使用；私有段或 ULA 段不行，因为那会把本地网络暴露给应用。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 工作方式：```text
web_fetch
   -> HttpFetchProvider.resolveAddresses
      -> 内置公网校验器
         -> 公网：原样通过

包装挂在 provider 实例的 own property（`resolveAddresses`）上。它刻意保持很小，因为它依赖 provider 的内部细节；见[局限](#局限)。

策略模块没有第三方 import，可以独立测试。完整威胁模型见 [docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md)。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 为什么不直接把整段加进白名单？：因为 `198.18.0.0/15` 不是 Fake-IP 解析器唯一可能返回的东西。如果校验器无条件接受这个段里的任何地址，那么：

- 一条指向本地服务的 DNS 应答就能通过 `web_fetch` 访问；
- `http://198.18.0.1/` 这样的 IP 字面量会完全绕过校验器；
- 混合应答（一条合成、一条真实）会产生歧义，pin 到哪个地址都不安全。

插件保留原有的全部拒绝逻辑，只为普通域名增加一条狭窄、可配置的合成路径。
section: 为什么不直接把整段加进白名单？

text:
dsh-fakeip-http README · 局限：- 只包装内置的 `http` fetch provider。若把 `web.fetchProvider` 切到别的 provider，本插件不生效。
- 只处理 `web_fetch` 使用的 provider。`web_search`、模型请求、MCP 等走各自的 HTTP 客户端，本来就不做“公网地址”判定，不需要本插件。
- 若 Fake-IP 转发器把某个公网域名映射到内网地址，那属于转发器策略；本插件拦截的是“应用直接访问内网”，不能替代转发器自身的规则审计。
- 依赖 provider 的 `resolveAddresses` 是实例 own property。Harness 升级若改变该内部结构，插件需要跟着调整；更合适的长期做法是把本策略合并进 `dsh-web-fetch-http` 的 Config。
- 合成段没有被 TUN 路由时，连接会失败。这是转发器配置问题，不是策略拒绝。
- Split DNS 对同一个域名同时返回合成地址和真实地址时，插件按设计拒绝；请修正 split-horizon 规则，而不是让插件猜测。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 检查 |
| --- | --- |
| `web_fetch` 仍报非公网地址 | 确认 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 中插件已激活；确认 `web.fetchProvider` 是 `http`；确认 DNS 应答在配置的 `cidrs` 内，而不是别的段。 |
| 只有 IPv6 站点失败 | 转发器返回了未配置的 IPv6 合成段，或 A/AAAA 返回了混合族。补上 IPv6 段。 |
| `web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:1203/` 反而成功 | 这是安全回归。校验器必须拒绝它；请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。 |
| 校验通过后连接超时 | TUN 没运行，或没有路由该合成段。检查转发器。 |
| 日志出现 `no safe fake-IP ranges` | 所有配置段都与特殊用途段重叠。换一个非私有的合成段。 |
| 日志出现 `built-in http fetch provider not found` | 本行比 provider 先激活，且 10 秒重试已用完。用标准的 `web-fetch-http` bundle 重启；若仍复现，请附上组合配置开 issue。 |
dsh-fakeip-http README · 安全：策略刻意保守。攻击模型、拒绝的段列表和残余风险见 [docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md)。发现绕过请通过 GitHub Security Advisories 私下报告，见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 兼容性：| 组件 | 支持范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（`engines.dsh`） |
| Fetch provider | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 的内置 `http` provider |
| Node（仅开发） | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0` |

插件在 Node 24 上用合成 DNS 应答做了单元测试。provider 集成遵循内置 provider 的 `resolveAddresses` 约定，但未针对每一种转发器做端到端验证。

dsh-fakeip-http README · 开发：没有依赖，也没有构建步骤：

```sh
npm test          # node --test：策略、provider 包装、manifest
npm run pack:check
```

目录：

```text
index.js                provider 包装与生命周期
lib/policy.js           域名、CIDR 与特殊用途段策略
test/policy.test.mjs    解析与地址段安全测试
test/plugin.test.mjs    包装安装/卸载与 apply 生命周期

在真实 profile 中调试，从仓库根目录执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh web --profile web
```

Host 改动需要重启进程。插件没有 Client 部分，重启后不需要刷新页面。
